reason: Substantive citation/date/verification-label defects and incomplete priority coverage

findings.subject: DHS voter-data lawsuit
findings.notes: AP independently reports the lawsuit as an allegation, not an adjudicated finding. The underlying filed complaint was not inspected, and the single AP link cannot satisfy Corroborated requirement.
findings.recommended_label: Unsubstantiated or Unverified pending docket review

findings.subject: Dollar and Treasury market movements
findings.notes: A single Reuters-syndicated article does not satisfy the project's two demonstrably independent source rule for Corroborated. Intraday observations, units and Fed remarks not captured.

findings.subject: Federal Reserve meetings
findings.notes: Fed recent-postings page dated Oct 13 lists Oct 19 discount-rate meeting; Oct 15 posting lists an Oct 20 financial-markets meeting. The candidate conflated publication and meeting dates.
findings.recommended_label: Refuted as phrased; corrected schedule can be reported separately

findings.subject: Texas bills signed
findings.notes: Texas report page stamped Oct 15 2026 is a live listing for the 89th Legislature second called session; cited bill last actions are Sep 2025. Report timestamp is not enactment date and is not a new Oct 2026 legislative action.
findings.recommended_label: Refuted as 2026 enactment news; historical legislative context only

findings.subject: USDA poultry releases
findings.notes: USDA calendar lists Turkey Hatchery Oct13, Broiler Hatchery Oct14 pending, Slaughter Weekly Oct15 pending, but Poultry Slaughter Oct23 pending rather than Oct15. Publication statuses must distinguish schedule from actual release.
findings.recommended_label: Unverified or corrected specific calendar listing

findings.subject: AI data center development
findings.notes: Links point to broad trade-news indices without exact project, dated permit, land-deed, filing, or independently retrievable claimed event.
findings.recommended_label: Unsubstantiated until individual projects and records identified

findings.subject: FMCSA contractor cyber incident
findings.notes: Both cited secondary summaries reference Politico/DOT; independent corroboration and first-hand government or vendor statement not established. DOT statement is an attributed assertion, not independent verification of no data exposure.

findings.subject: Arkansas and Oklahoma elections/energy
findings.notes: Combines two jurisdictions in 'arkansas/oklahoma', which is not valid schema; unrelated local stories are bundled and no official election/legislative records support concrete action.
findings.recommended_label: Unverified; split by jurisdiction and by factual assertion

required_fixes: Preserve report generation date; never call 22:05 CT a 06:00 start-of-day baseline.
Require each item to have a supported recognized jurisdiction; split multi-jurisdiction assertions.
Enforce Corroborated requires independent origins, not merely multiple downstream articles.
Distinguish live page update times from underlying legislative actions and effective dates.
Distinguish scheduled, pending and published statistical releases.
Use specific source records instead of news indexes or homepages.
Retain explicit source-level finding and uncertainties rather than promoting model labels.
